remaining_protocols.protocol: Public Qt transition effects/reasons and downstream Store/publication aggregation
remaining_protocols.reason: Actual cancel/abort/private-replacement consumers still transfer effects through Qt packets; this package prepares the producer output before Debt/install but does not pay or eliminate every downstream copy.
remaining_protocols.delete_when: Migrate the actual producer-to-queue responsibility and original consumer aggregation together; retain identity, batch scheduling and no-loss acceptance.

remaining_protocols.protocol: Qt reference/registration/diagnostic snapshots and Transition inputs
remaining_protocols.reason: Full external invariant validation and snapshot/oracle consumers still require their public value contract; private paid working values are not authoritative records.
remaining_protocols.delete_when: Only after those actual consumer interfaces migrate or their bootstrap/output costs are explicitly covered.

remaining_protocols.protocol: Generic paid preparation, revision/claim/physical refusals and original Failed/cancel
remaining_protocols.reason: Working arrays, arena/index/activity/physical-batch preparation and paid proof/overlay capacity still may refuse before install; scheduler does not yet transfer original job ownership.
remaining_protocols.delete_when: A complete acceptance guarantee across the actual CP1/CP5 consumers removes the real failure, rather than only paying one working container.

remaining_protocols.protocol: Read/capture progress, Pending/subscription/Delay/Debt and history/epoch handoff
remaining_protocols.reason: These represent distinct non-replayable facts and actual readiness, identity or budget refusals; no new guarantee in this package removes them.
remaining_protocols.delete_when: Equivalent preparation and acceptance guarantees cover release/ack/cancel/close and late guards.
